name: Cascade Server
description: Server companion for the Cascade music player. Fetches lyrics and keeps them on the server so every user shares them: word-level karaoke from Kugou, synced and plain lyrics from LRCLIB, and, with your own SpicyLyrics key, SpicyLyrics' word-synced lyrics, matched to songs through ListenBrainz. Cascade users can link a song to its Spotify track by hand when the match finds nothing; admins choose whose links apply to everyone. Includes a lyrics coverage page and a scheduled task to fetch lyrics for the whole library.
overview: Lyrics for the Cascade music player: Kugou karaoke, LRCLIB and SpicyLyrics, shared server-wide.
